onset.Description: Onset of the event, measured from the beginning of the acquisition.

condition_hash.Description: The hash for the stimulus condition.

rng_seed.Description: Random number generate seed for the stimulus movie.

xnodes.Description: The x dimension of low-res phase movie.

ynodes.Description: The y dimension of low-res phase movie.

temp_freq.Description: The temporal frequency if the phase pattern were static (Hz).

temp_kernel_length.Description: The length of Hanning kernel for the temporal filter, controls the rate of change of the phase pattern.

spatial_freq.Description: The approximate max spatial frequency. The actual frequencies may be higher. (cy/point).

pattern_aspect.Description: The aspect ratio of generated pattern.

temp_bandwidth.Description: The temporal bandwidth of the stimulus (Hz).

ori_coherence.Description: 1=unoriented noise. pi / ori coherence = bandwidth of orientation kernel.

ori_fraction.Description: The fraction of stimulus with coherent orientation vs unoriented.

ori_mix.Description: The mixin-coefficient of orientation biased noise.

short_movie_name.Description: The type of the clip (cinematic, sports1m, rendered).

nwb_table.Description: The name of the NWB table from which this event was extracted.

Levels.Trippy: The 'Trippy' table in the NWB file.
Levels.Monet2: The 'Monet2' table in the NWB file.
Levels.Clip: The 'Clip' table in the NWB file.

Trippy.Description: The stimulus table for the cosine of a smoothened noise phase movie.

Monet2.Description: Generated from smoothened Gaussian noise and a global orientation and direction component.

Clip.Description: Composed of 10 second clips from cinematic releases, Sports-1M dataset, or custom rendered first person POV videos in 3D environment in Unreal Engine.
